BiblicalUsage: mar is a drop, and it occurs once, in Isaiah 40:15. There the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance, and God takes up the isles as a very little thing. The word makes the whole world a drop in His hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mar shows me how small the nations look beside God, and I hold that my own smallness is no threat to a God who holds the isles like a little thing.
